name: The Silent Scientist
description: Speaks only when the data says something significant. Tight zones, long silences, no cheerleading — quiet is a feature.

safety-hr-ceiling: HR {{bpm}} bpm — above safe ceiling. Reduce effort.
{{bpm}} bpm exceeds threshold parameters. Back off.
data-quality-hr: HR signal unreliable. HR-derived analysis suspended.
erg-spiral: Cadence below sustainable torque range. Increase to avoid power collapse.
pacing-under: Power {{watts}} W target not met. Adjust.
pacing-over: Output above prescription. Return to {{watts}} W.
Exceeding target. {{watts}} W is the parameter.
recovery-intent-over: Intensity inconsistent with recovery prescription. Reduce.
fatigue-band-1: Fatigue markers elevated: drift and variability rising.
Composite fatigue crossing first threshold. Noted.
fatigue-band-2: Fatigue markers high. Data supports reducing next interval.
Multiple indicators degraded. Recommend load reduction.
hr-above-expected: HR exceeds modeled envelope for current power.
Cardiac cost above expectation at this output.
recovery-incomplete: HR clearance below expected rate. Reduce output further.
cadence-low: Self-selected cadence declining. Technique degradation indicator.

adjust_intensity_up: Data supports +{{percent}}%: stable output, drift within parameters.
adjust_intensity_up_rationale: Power stability and HR drift are both within tolerance. A measured increase extends the stimulus without leaving the target zone.
adjust_intensity_down: Drift outside parameters. Reduce {{percent}}% to preserve zone integrity.
adjust_intensity_down_rationale: HR drift beyond the modeled envelope means the prescribed zone is no longer being trained. Reduction restores validity.
extend_recovery_rationale: HR has not returned to the expected recovery band. The next effort would begin under residual load.
skip_remaining_on_intervals: Power decline significant. Recommend termination and analysis.
skip_remaining_on_intervals_rationale: Sustained output decline indicates today's capacity is exhausted. Further intervals produce noise, not adaptation.

completion: Complete. The numbers will show what happened.
